# European regional references

Region: Europe. Sources verified 2026-10-11. Scope follows source documentation, not assumed nationwide CAMT availability.

## Country / regional references

### EBA CLEARING

**Role:** Pan-European interbank payment system operator (EURO1, STEP2-T, RT1)

**Reporting coverage:** Public ISO 20022 payment-clearing information; reviewed pages do not establish CAMT 052/053/054 customer-reporting profiles.

**Messages / versions:** ISO20022 (interbank payments); camt.056 (cancellation)

- [STEP2 advanced standard functionality](https://www.ebaclearing.eu/services-sepa-payments/step2-t/advanced-standard-functionality/) — availability; public-page
- [EURO1 ISO 20022 migration, March 2023](https://www.ebaclearing.eu/large-value-payment-system-euro1-successfully-migrates-to-iso-20022/?stream=press_releases) — availability; public-page
- [Public ISO 20022 harmonisation response, May 2023](https://www.ebaclearing.eu/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/eba-clearings-response-to-the-cpmi-consultative-report-on-iso-20022-harmonisation-requirements_may-2023.pdf) — payment-guideline; public-file

Public sources establish interbank ISO 20022 and 056 cancellation, not a bank-to-customer statement profile. EBA CLEARING is distinct from the European Banking Authority.

### European Central Bank / Eurosystem

**Role:** TARGET payment infrastructure operator and technical documentation publisher

**Reporting coverage:** Central-bank account reporting in TARGET services; 053 statements and 052/054 reporting appear in public documents. Context differs from commercial bank customer reporting.

**Messages / versions:** camt.052; camt.053; camt.054; pacs; head; camt (liquidity/control)

- [TARGET shared features and documentation entry](https://www.ecb.europa.eu/paym/target/coco/html/index.en.html) — availability; public-page
- [TIPS consultative documents including 052/053 proposals](https://www.ecb.europa.eu/paym/target/tips/profuse/html/index_meetdocs.en.html) — availability; public-page
- [TIPS change requests including 054 business date](https://www.ecb.europa.eu/paym/target/tips/governance/html/changerequests.en.html) — availability; public-page
- [Historical 2018 ISO 20022 message list](https://www.ecb.europa.eu/paym/groups/shared/docs/e6f8a-t2-t2s-2018-03-14-tccg-iso-20022-messaging-excel.pdf) — specification; public-file

Public entry points and reporting-message context verified; current production namespaces not verified. Change proposals are not implemented requirements. National central-bank TARGET contracts are not national corporate CAMT profiles.

### European Payments Council (EPC)

**Role:** Pan-European SEPA payment-scheme owner and customer-reporting recommendation publisher

**Reporting coverage:** Direct mapping of SEPA transaction details into CAMT 052/053/054 v08; recommendation rather than a bank-specific full statement profile.

**Messages / versions:** camt.052.001.08; camt.053.001.08; camt.054.001.08; pacs; pain

- [EPC 188-09 customer-reporting recommendation 5.0](https://www.europeanpaymentscouncil.eu/document-library/guidance-documents/epc-recommendation-iso-20022-customer-reporting-scts-oct-inst) — availability; public-page
- [EPC 188-09 v 5.0, April 2025 PDF](https://www.europeanpaymentscouncil.eu/sites/default/files/kb/file/2025-04/EPC188-09%20v5.0%20Recommendation%20on%20Customer%20Reporting%20SCTs%2C%20OCT%20Inst%20and%20SDDs.pdf) — specification; public-file

Version 5.0 dated 2025-04-25, effective 2025-10-05, covers SCT, SDD and OCT Inst. It primarily maps TransactionDetails rather than defining a complete account-report profile. It is neither a national guide nor a bank-published sample.
